cli_failure.code: The command failed with exit code {code}.

brain.nothing_found: I couldn't find anything on that.
brain.evidence_unfulfilled: I couldn't retrieve that just now — the tool call didn't go through. Say the word and I'll try again.
brain.evidence_unfulfilled_domain: I couldn't pull {label} just now — the access didn't go through. Say the word and I'll try again.

action_unfulfilled.society_propose_change: The routine was not created. The save action did not run.
action_unfulfilled.society-create-routine: The routine was not created. The save action did not run.
action_unfulfilled.contact-upsert: I haven't actually saved that contact yet — give me the details once more and I'll add it.
action_unfulfilled.wiki-ingest: I haven't actually noted that in your wiki yet — say it once more and I'll write it down.
action_unfulfilled.run_shell: I haven't actually done that yet — the command never ran. Say it once more and I'll do it right away.

brain.lang_switch_confirm_session: For this session I'll reply in English — saving it permanently didn't work.
brain.subagent_switch_confirm: Done — your sub-agent will run on {p} from your next mission.

subagent_switch_fail.missing_credential: {p} isn't connected — set it up first, then I'll switch.
subagent_switch_fail.other: I couldn't switch the sub-agent to {p}.

brain.provider_switch_confirm: Done — your main brain now runs on {p}.

provider_switch_fail.missing_credential: {p} isn't set up — add its key first, then I'll switch.
provider_switch_fail.subagent_only: {p} only works as a sub-agent, not as the main brain.
provider_switch_fail.other: I couldn't switch the main brain to {p}.

depth_confirm.deep: Got it — I'll think more deeply from now on.
depth_confirm.fast: Got it — I'll think faster from now on.

provider_down: Sorry, I can't reach my language model right now. One moment, please.
I'm afraid my language model is unavailable at the moment. I'll try again shortly.
I can't answer just now — my connection to the model is failing. Give me a second.

provider_down_cause.missing_key: Sorry — no API key is set for my language model right now. Open the API keys in the sidebar and add one, and I can continue right away.
provider_down_cause.bad_key: Sorry — my stored API key is being rejected; it looks invalid or expired. Please replace it under API keys in the sidebar.
provider_down_cause.account_blocked: Sorry — my language model's account is blocking right now, most likely the credit is used up or a limit was reached. Please take a look at the provider account.
provider_down_cause.rate_limit: Sorry — my provider is throttling me for too many requests. Give it a moment and just ask me again.
provider_down_cause.invalid_model: Sorry — the configured model is not accepted by the provider. Please check the model selection in the settings.
provider_down_cause.context_overflow: Sorry — this request is too large for the configured model; its context window is too small for it. Pick a model with a larger context or start a new chat.
provider_down_cause.local_context: Sorry — your local model runs with a context window too small for this request. Raise the context length in your local model server and reload the model; for the models under Local Models, use Tune. The log names the size it needs.
provider_down_cause.unreachable: Sorry — I can't reach my provider right now, likely a network or provider issue. Please try again in a moment.
provider_down_cause.vision_unsupported: Sorry — none of the connected assistants can inspect images right now. The key is there; vision is not. Pick a vision-capable provider under API keys.

brain.mid_answer_error: I ran the steps, but something went wrong while composing the answer. Please ask me again in a moment.
brain.action_failed: I recognized the action but couldn't execute it.
brain.lang_switch_confirm: Done — I'll reply in English from now on.
brain.lang_switch_confirm_auto: Done — from now on I'll match the language you use.

tool_loop.anti_silence: I can't do that right now — I'm missing the right tool for it.
tool_loop.meta_debug_ack: Understood. What exactly should have been different?

speech.brain_unavailable: Sorry, Ruben — I can't reach any of my language models right now. Please check whether your providers still have credit.
speech.stt_unavailable: Sorry, I didn't catch that just now. Could you say it again?
speech.realtime_unavailable: The realtime connection is unavailable right now. I am switching this session to the classic voice pipeline.
speech.timeout_tool_stall: I couldn't get an answer in time. A tool I was waiting on didn't respond.
speech.timeout_no_answer: I couldn't find that out just now.

failure_reason.review_time_budget_exhausted: The review time budget was reached; partial output is available.
failure_reason.decompose_failed: I could not break the task down.
failure_reason.crash_recovery: An old mission was cleaned up.
failure_reason.interrupted: A running mission was interrupted; the partial results are available.
failure_reason.critic_unavailable: The reviewer crashed; the work is preserved in the worktree.
failure_reason.worktree_setup_failed: I could not create a workspace.
failure_reason.checkpoint_missing: The saved progress is missing, so I cannot continue.
failure_reason.git_missing: {agents} require git to be installed and on PATH.
failure_reason.git_not_a_repository: {agents} require a git checkout (install via the git-based installer, not a ZIP download).
failure_reason.source_checkout_unavailable: This {agent} task requires the source checkout, which is not available in this installation.
failure_reason.provider_auth: The AI provider sign-in is invalid or expired.
failure_reason.provider_quota: The AI provider's quota is exhausted.
failure_reason.provider_unreachable: The AI provider is currently unreachable.
failure_reason.worker_timeout: The worker hit its time limit.

readback.no_tool_call: I could not do that — no tool call was made.

realtime.local_output_failure: I couldn't play that just now. The speaker disappeared.
realtime.output_language_failure: I couldn't produce a safe answer in English just now.

handshake_failure.timeout: The voice connection did not come up in time, so I stopped.
handshake_failure.unavailable: I couldn't establish the voice connection just now.
handshake_failure.rate_limited: The voice connection is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
handshake_failure.no_credits: The credit for the voice connection is used up. Top it up with the provider and it will work again.
handshake_failure.not_offered: Your account does not offer this voice connection right now. Check its plan or select another account.

short_error.reload: the reload test rejected the new value
short_error.rollback: the rollback itself failed — a manual restore is needed
short_error.unexpected: an unexpected error while changing the setting
